title: Clean Armor HUD
description: A clean armour hud mod which provides a vareity of options to choose from.
body:
# **Clean Armor Hud**

A light weight client-side Fabric mod for Minecraft that adds a fully customizable, modern armor HUD.
check gallery for better understanding.

## Features
- User Friendly GUI with the best features possible
- Offhand display
- Drag-and-drop repositioning anywhere on screen
- Rotation, scale, spacing, and alignment controls
- Durability display modes: percentage, numeric, or hidden
- Optional Durability Bar 
- Hide vanilla armor bar option
- Automatically Adjusts the bars when placed horizontally and vertically
  

## Usage
- In-game, press 'H' to open the Armor HUD Editor
- Adjust settings in the left panel 
- Click Move HUD to drag the HUD anywhere on screen
- Click Done to save
